name: 2025.04.02 April PC Meeting Agenda Page
agenda_text:
CITY OF INGLEWOOD
  DEVELOPMENT SERVICES DEPARTMENT
  PLANNING DIVISION
  PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING AGENDA
April 2, 2025, 7:00 P.M.
City Council Chambers – Ninth Floor
1 West Manchester Boulevard

1.  Pledge of Allegiance.

2.  Roll Call.

3.  Communications from staff.

4.  Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items. Persons wishing to address
  the Planning Commission on any item on the agenda other than a
  public hearing may do so at this time.

5.  Minute(s) approval for February  5,  2025,  and  March  2,  2025,
  Planning Commission meeting(s).

6.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:
  a. A public hearing to consider an application by Alchemy
  Planning plus Land Use for Zone Change No. 23-00002 (ZC23-
  00002) to allow a zone change for 6 parcels from MU-1 (Mixed
  Use 1) to M-1 (Light Manufacturing) and a portion of those
  parcels from M-1 (Light Manufacturing) to MU-1 (Mixed Use
  1) on a 3.99-acres site at 308 East Beach Avenue. There is
  no specific development application submitted associated
  with the zone change request.

  THIS ITEM HAS BEEN POSTPONED TO THE MAY 7, 2025, PLANNING
  COMMISSION MEETING AND WILL BE RE-NOTICED.

  b. A public hearing to consider an application by East Beach,
  LLC for Zone Change No. 23-00003 (ZC23-00003) to allow a
  zone change for 14 parcels from M-1 (Light Manufacturing)
  and R-2 (Limited Multiple-family Residential) to MU-1 (Mixed
  Use 1) on a 2.93-acre site at 338 East Beach Avenue. There
  is no specific development application submitted associated
  with the zone change request.

  THIS ITEM HAS BEEN POSTPONED TO THE MAY 7, 2025, PLANNING
  COMMISSION MEETING AND WILL BE RE-NOTICED.

  c. A public hearing to consider an application by Princess
  Griffen, for Special Use Permit No. 24-00031(SUP24-00031)
  to allow a tattoo parlor within a one-story multiple-tenant
  commercial building on an approximately 6,300 square foot
  C-2 (General Commercial)/Live-work Overlay zoned property
  at 1204 North La Brea Avenue.

  Preliminary Recommendation
  A. If the Planning Commission determines to APPROVE the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the categorical exemption EA-CE-2025-033;
  2) Adopt the resolution approving SUP24-00031.
  B. If  the  Planning  Commission  determines  to  ADD
  CONDITIONS, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of
  conditions as appropriate.
  C. If the Planning Commission determines to DENY the
  request or any part thereof, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6c Documents
   d. A  public hearing to consider an application by WePlay
  Esports Media, Inc., for Special Use Permit No. 25-
  00007(SUP25-00007) to allow 1) an assembly use for an event
  center, 2) the on-site consumption of beer, wine, and
  distilled spirits, and 3) shared parking for infrequent
  users on an approximately 27,600 square-foot MU-2 (TOD
  Mixed Use-2) zoned property at 235 West Florence Avenue.

  Preliminary Recommendation
  A. Consider the staff report and the public testimony and
  make a determination. If the Planning Commission
  determines to approve the request, it is recommended to:
  1) Affirm the categorical exemption EA-CE-2025-034; and
  a. Adopt the attached resolution approving SUP25-00007
  b. Assembly use for an event center;
  c. The on-site consumption of beer, wine, and
  distilled spirits
  d. Live entertainment, and
  e. Shared parking for infrequent users
  B. Should the Planning Commission determine to ADD
  CONDITIONS, it is recommended to:
  1) Take the above actions but modify the number of
  conditions as appropriate.
  C. Should the Planning Commission determine to DENY the
  request, it is recommended to:
  1) That the appropriate actions and make the findings.
  Item 6d Documents

7.  Public Comments. Anyone wishing to address the Planning
  Commission on any matter within their jurisdiction and not
  elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

8.  Commission Initiatives.

9.  Adjournment.

If you will require special accommodations, due to a disability, please
contact the Planning Division at (310) 412-5230, One Manchester
Boulevard, Fourth Floor, Inglewood City Hall, Inglewood, CA 90301. All
requests for special accommodations must be received 48 hours prior to
the day of the hearing(s).

"Si no entiende esta noticia o si necesita más información, favor de
llamar a este número (310) 412-5230."

In the event that the Planning Commission meeting of April 2, 2025, is
not held, or is concluded prior to a public hearing or other agenda item
being considered, the public hearing or non-public hearing agenda item
will automatically be continued to the next regular Planning Commission
meeting.

  NEXT PLANNING COMMISSION MEETING:
  WEDNESDAY, MAY 7, 2025, AT 7:00 P.M.
  CITY COUNCIL CHAMBERS, NINTH FLOOR, INGLEWOOD CITY HALL
  ONE MANCHESTER BOULEVARD
  INGLEWOOD, CA 90301
